s: Look at the picture. The man is looking for money but does not notice that it is in the top 　　　.【101年基測】
e: 圖中可以看到這個男人正在翻箱倒櫃找錢，他是在抽屜裡找東西，而最上面的那個抽屜裡有錢，所以答案要選(Ｄ)drawer。

s: The traffic light turned red when I was going to cross the road.  But I didn’t 　　　 and was almost hit by a motorcycle.【101年基測】
e: 句中是過馬路的情境，紅燈應該是要停下來，句中寫差點被摩托車撞到，所以應該是沒有停下來，因此答案要選(Ｃ)stop。

s: I planned to fly to Hong Kong today.  But when I got to the 　　　, I found it was closed because of the heavy rain.【101年基測】
e: “fly to” 是搭飛機去某地的意思，飛機要到機場去搭，所以答案要選(Ａ)airport。

s: in the daytime is not good for you.  You may not sleep well at night and feel tired the next day.【101年基測】
e: 本題考的是「動詞變化」，主詞是 “Sleeping in the daytime” ，白天睡覺是一件事情，此為動名詞當主詞，所以答案要選(Ｄ)Sleeping。

s: Melody has a great interest in planting flowers, but her sister 　　　.  She can’t even stay in the garden for one minute.【101年基測】
e: 本題考的是「時態」，從 “Melody has” 得知是現在簡單式，所以要先刪除(Ａ)can’t和(Ｄ)won’t（未來式），又因為前句有動詞 “has” ，所以要選擇代替前面動詞的助動詞doesn’t，因此答案要選(Ｂ)。

s: John has finished his studies at music school.  Now with his good 　　　 of music, he can teach at school.【101年基測】
e: 因為John在音樂學校唸書，又可以在學校教書，所以需要具備音樂的知識才能勝任，因此答案選(Ｃ)knowledge。

s: I 　　　 a bath when someone turned off the light.  I was scared and shouted for help.【101年基測】
e: 本題是考「時態」，整體情境在描述「過去」發生的一件事，句中也有關鍵字 “turned” 、 “was” 、 “shouted” 表明了這是在「過去」發生的一件事情，且句中要表達的是「我正在洗澡的這一個持續動作」，所以要用過去進行式(Ａ)was taking。

s: At the end of the baseball game, all the players 　　　 the fans to thank them for coming to the game.【101年基測】
e: 因為句中提到要謝謝球迷來看比賽，所以鞠躬就是一種感謝的表達方式，因此要選(Ｃ)bowed to。

s: Can you help me 　　　 those cups and dishes?  I get a different number each time.【101年基測】
e: 句中透露了 “get a different number” ，因此應該是要請人幫忙再數一次，所以要選(Ｄ)count。

s: I have a big 　　　 at home.  I often fill it with hot water and enjoy a long bath.【101年基測】
e: 因為句中提到「熱水填滿」，又提到「泡澡」，泡澡應該要在浴缸裡，所以答案要選(Ｃ)tub。

s: We know 　　　 about the new boss except that she just came back from the US.  We hope to know her better.【101年基測】
e: 因為是新老闆，而且後面又表達希望更了解她，代表句中想表達的是不了解她，因此答案要選(Ｂ)nothing。

s: See?  The strange man I saw yesterday 　　　 around my house again.  Should I call the police?【101年基測】
e: 本題是考「時態」，I saw yesterday是形容詞子句，修飾前面的先行詞The strange man，代表昨天看到的，但句中詢問是否要叫警察，表示奇怪的男人此刻現在正在屋外走來走去，所以時態上應該要用現在進行式，因此答案要選(Ｂ)is walking。

s: I haven’t been to the movies these days.  Are there any good 　　　 this week?【101年基測】
e: ones是不定代名詞的複數形式，代替前面提過的電影，又因為句中使用Are there，所以需要使用複數，因此答案要選(Ａ)ones。

s:
Cindy: Do you want some bread?
Allen: I need more than that. I’m so 　　　!【101年基測】
e: 因為Cindy問Allen要不要吃麵包，Allen回答要更多，表示他應該很餓，所以答案要選(Ｂ)hungry。

s:
Grace: Wow! Is your room always this 　　　?
Bianca: Well, I like to put everything in the right place.【101年基測】
e: 因為Bianca喜歡把東西都放到正確的地方，表示她的房間應該很整齊，因此答案要選(Ｃ)tidy。

s:
(On the cell phone)
Stacy: Where are you? I can’t see you here at the theater.
Greg: 　　　. I’m just one block away.【101年基測】
e: 文中情境是Stacy跟Greg約在電影院，但是Greg還沒到，而Greg說他再一個路口就到了，所以應該是快到了，因此要選(Ｂ)I’m coming。

s:
Dad: Are you going out? It’s really late now.
Mitch: I know, but it’s the last day to buy tickets to the World Cup games, 　　　 I must go.【101年基測】
e: 本題是考連接詞的語意，文中Mitch表達今天是售票的最後一天，跟現在必須出去有因果關係，因此要選(Ｃ)so。

s:
Abby: Too bad you couldn’t come to the beach with us. It was so much fun there! You must come next time.
Bree: No, thanks. I don’t think 　　　 any fun. I can’t swim.【101年基測】
e: 本題考的是「時態」，雖然Abby表達的是之前去沙灘的經驗，但是後來表達了「下次」可以一起去玩，所以時態從「過去式」轉換到「未來式」，而因為Bree拒絕Abby的邀約，表明自己不會游泳，所以去了也不會玩得開心，但在說這句話的時候「還沒有去」，所以答案選未來式(Ｄ)I’ll have。

s: Below is what Stan drew for his report. It shows the number of students in each club at his school in 2009 and 2010. Which is NOT true?【101年基測】
o: The art clubs have fewer students in 2010 than in 2009.
The sports clubs have more students in 2010 than in 2009.
The acting club is the most popular club both in 2009 and in 2010.
In 2009, the painting club has half the number of students of the paper-cutting club.
e: (Ａ)藝術性社團＝剪紙＋表演＋繪畫，在2009年是245位學生，在2010年是190位學生，所以2010年的學生數比2009年的學生數少是正確的。(Ｂ)運動性社團＝足球＋網球＋棒球，在2009年是215位學生，在2010年是270位學生，所以2010年的學生數比2009年的學生數多是正確的。(Ｃ)戲劇社在2009年及2010年學生數都不是最多的，所以本選項是錯的。(Ｄ)2009年繪畫社學生人數是50人，剪紙社學生人數是100人，所以本選項是對的。因此答案選(Ｃ)。

p: 【101年基測】
e: 本題是考「時態」，文中Linda說她忘記了Jean的生日，忘記是已經過去的動作，所以應該要用過去式，因此答案選(Ｂ)I forgot。

p: 【101年基測】
e: 文中Linda一開始想不起來是什麼事情忘記了，但是「終於」想起來了，所以答案要選(Ｂ)finally。

p: 【101年基測】
e: 本題是考「時態」，Linda問Jean生日玩得開心嗎，文中透露出Jean的生日是在兩個星期前，是過去的事情，所以答案要選過去式(Ｄ)did you have。

p:
If you sail between Hawaii and California, you’ll find a big part of the ocean, as big as Africa, covered with garbage. Most of the trash comes from the land, by wind or by water, and some is thrown straight into the sea. Most of the trash is plastic: plastic bags, plastic cups, plastic cans, and a lot more.
　　　(1)　? Some just stays in the sea, some is washed onto the beaches, and, worst of all, some 　(2)　. Many seabirds and sea animals that eat the trash in the sea die. Those that are lucky enough to live on may someday arrive on our dinner plate. What we throw away will all 　(3)　 one way or another.
　　Keep in mind what happens to trash, and you may think twice before you throw anything away.
【101年基測】
o: How do we deal with the trash
Where does the trash come from
How does the trash arrive un the sea
e: 根據下文（Some just stays in the sea, some is washed onto the beaches...）得知這些垃圾的去向，因此本題答案選(Ａ)。

s: (１)What did Jamie plan to do this afternoon?
p:
Jamie: Hey, Paul, will you be home this afternoon?
Paul: Yes, why?
Jamie: Can I come over to your house to play basketball in the yard?
Paul: But don’t you have class at New Math Classroom today? I remember you have to go there on Mondays and Wednesdays.
Jamie: Yes, but I sleep most of the time during the class. What the teacher says is almost like a foreign language to me. I don’t know why I should be there.
Paul: But your parents will be here in one hour to have tea with my parents.
Jamie: Oh, no!
【101年基測】
o: To go to a math class.
e: 根據內文（Can I come over to your house to play basketball in the yard?），Jamie今天想去Paul家打籃球，因此答案選(Ａ)。

s: (２)What do we know from the dialogue?
p:
Jamie: Hey, Paul, will you be home this afternoon?
Paul: Yes, why?
Jamie: Can I come over to your house to play basketball in the yard?
Paul: But don’t you have class at New Math Classroom today? I remember you have to go there on Mondays and Wednesdays.
Jamie: Yes, but I sleep most of the time during the class. What the teacher says is almost like a foreign language to me. I don’t know why I should be there.
Paul: But your parents will be here in one hour to have tea with my parents.
Jamie: Oh, no!
【101年基測】
o: Paul’s parents work at New Math Classroom.
Jamie’s teacher at New Math Classroom is a foreigner.
There is no class at New Math Classroom on Wednesdays.
Jamie does not enjoy the math class at New Math Classroom.
e: 根據內文（I don’t know why I should be there.），Jamie並不喜歡New Math Classroom的數學課，因此答案選(Ｄ)。

s: (１)What did Luke do on the farm?
p:
Read Luke’s diary and answer the questions.

【101年基測】
o: He helped to milk the cows.
He sold milk for Mr. Chang.
He learned how to make cheese.
He collected fresh grass for Mr. Chang.
e: 根據內文When he milked the cows, he even let us try.，句中的he是指Mr. Chang，整句話的意思是當Mr. Chang在擠牛乳的時候，他還讓我們試試看，代表Luke在農場上有幫忙擠牛乳。

s: (２)What did Mr. Chang NOT do for his cows?
p:
Read Luke’s diary and answer the questions.

【101年基測】
o: He fed them with spring water.
He touched and talked to them.
He played music when they ate.
He let them walk freely on the farm.
e: 根據內文，Mr. Chang沒有在牛吃草時放音樂給牠們聽，故選(Ｃ)。

s: (１)What does the webpage of www.sweethome.com/mothergoose look like?
p: 【101年基測】
e: 從文中With Mother Goose, you can play with different ideas on the computer, so you can see what your future house will look like before starting the real job.可知Mother Goose提供了模擬家具擺放效果的服務，因此答案選(Ｄ)。

p: 【101年基測】
o: It is new on the market.
It is popular with young people.
People can visit its office next week.
People can buy three packs and get one free.
e: 根據文意Sweethome.com will start selling Mother Goose next week.，可判斷Mother Goose應該是市場上的新品牌，銷售的產品即將在下週上市。

s: (１)What is the writer trying to say in the poem?
p:
You asked what kind of person I am.
I speak out what I think,
Loud like an angry queen;
I stay low,
Quiet like a winter tree.
I’m excited,
As happy as a jumping rabbit;
I’m bored,
Feeling like a dead fish.
What kind of person am I?
Who knows?
I live and wear different faces,
Like everyone else.
【101年基測】
o: It is not wise to show how we feel.
Life is hard when we forget how to smile.
It is not possible to make everybody happy.
It is hard to tell what a person is really like.
e: 詩中對於自己有很多面向的描述，如：表達自己的意見、像個憤怒的女王、行事低調、安靜的像冬天裡的樹、快樂的時候又像隻跳躍的兔子、感覺無聊時又像條死魚，前後詩句有很多的對比造成反差，且詩末I live and wear different faces，因此本詩要表達的是人是有很多面的，很難說清楚怎麼樣才是真正的自己。

s: (２)What can we know about the writer from the poem?
p:
You asked what kind of person I am.
I speak out what I think,
Loud like an angry queen;
I stay low,
Quiet like a winter tree.
I’m excited,
As happy as a jumping rabbit;
I’m bored,
Feeling like a dead fish.
What kind of person am I?
Who knows?
I live and wear different faces,
Like everyone else.
【101年基測】
o: She used to have many pets.
She cannot remember her real name.
She is not afraid to talk about her ideas.
e:
根據文意
I speak out what I think,
Loud like an angry queen;
表示想什麼就講什麼，因此(Ｄ)最合適。

s: (１)What happened in The Travel?
p:
Kirsten: Have you read The Travel? I just finished it yesterday.
Renee: No, but I’ve wanted to. Is it good?
Kirsten: It is! But it’s quite grim.
Renee: How so?
Kirsten: In the story, a mother and her son were on a trip when they were caught by a group of crazy people. They were kept in a small dark room and treated terribly. It really broke my heart to read that the mother chose to stay and fight with the bad guys. She was almost killed when trying to help her son run away.
Renee: So it’s this grim from the first page to the end?
Kirsten: Yes, but there’s still a bright side in it. You get to see how strong parents can be when they want to keep their children from being hurt.
Renee: I see. I’m surely going to borrow it from the library.
Kirsten: Then you must hurry. When I borrowed it last Friday, they told me that many people were waiting to read it!
【101年基測】
o: A mother did her best to save her child.
A mother took a trip to look for her son.
A mother was treated terribly by her family.
A mother was killed by a group of crazy people.
e: 整篇對話討論The Travel的情節，對話中重複提到一個母親盡全力去保護她的小孩，如：She was almost killed when trying to help her son run away.、You get to see how strong parents can be when they want to keep their children from being hurt.，因此正確答案為(Ａ)。

p:
Kirsten: Have you read The Travel? I just finished it yesterday.
Renee: No, but I’ve wanted to. Is it good?
Kirsten: It is! But it’s quite grim.

Kirsten: In the story, a mother and her son were on a trip when they were caught by a group of crazy people. They were kept in a small dark room and treated terribly. Kirsten: Yes, but there’s still a bright side in it. You get to see how strong parents can be when they want to keep their children from being hurt.

s: (１)What do we know about the Students' Night at Catch-Up?
p: 【101年基測】
o: The waiters will wear school uniforms.
Students who order before 7pm will get a free drink.
Catch-up will be open later on Students’ Night than on other days.
People who are not students still have a chance to get a special price.
e: 從 Not a student anymore? Dig out your old school uniform and wear it to Catch-Up!! 可以判斷即使不是學生也有機會取得特惠價格，因此答案選(Ｄ)。

s:
(２)Patty and her classmates went out to celebrate her 18th birthday. Below is the e-mail she had sent them the day before.
Date: Tuesday, July 27, 2010
Subject: Tomorrow Night
Dear Ginny, Jen, and Eva,
The movie starts at 7:00, so let's meet at 6:45 tomorrow.  Student tickets are cheaper, so do bring your student cards!  After the movie, we will have dinner at the famous Catch-Up!  See you tomorrow!
Patty
P.S. Don't forget to put on your best dress.

That night, one of Patty’s classmates did not bring her student card. How much did they pay for their dinner at Cath-up?
p: 【101年基測】
e: 她們要看七點的電影，因此她們用餐在七點後，有帶學生證的三人享受特惠價250元／每人，沒帶學生證的那位同學，從信中Patty提醒大家要穿著最美的洋裝出席，可推論她不是穿制服，使用原價350元的價格，故四人共花1,100元。

s: (１)What do we know about the six people?
p:
Six people are talking about two pie shops in a TV program.
Lily: I’ve been going to Pie House for twenty years. Now Marie’s son is taking care of the business, and he makes pies as good as his mother’s.

Olive: I went to Pie Corner once. Their pies were great, too. But I feel more comfortable at Pie House.

Ned: Uncle Roy used to work for my mom. Later he opened Pie Corner on the next block after he got married.

Marie: Roy was already quite avant-garde when working with me. I mean he had different, sometimes even strange, ideas about pies. There were times I thought his pies wouldn’t taste good, but they turned out magically delicious.

Lee: Ned has done quite well with Pie House. His pies make you feel warm. But if you want to try something interesting, you should go to Pie Corner.

Chuck: If eating Roy’s pies is like taking an exciting trip, then Ned’s pies are just like a sweet home you go back to after a long trip.
【101年基測】
o: They all have been to both pie shops.
They all talked about what the pies taste like.
Some of them are the shopkeepers of the pie shops.
Some of them talked about how the shopkeepers treated their workers.
e: 根據內文，受訪者Lily說： “Now Marie’s son is taking care of the business…” ，Ned說： “Uncle Roy used to work for my mom.” ，Marie說： “Roy was already quite avant-garde when working with me.” ，此三句皆可知道Marie和Ned是Pie House的老闆，因此答案選(Ｃ)受訪者中，有些人是派餅店的老闆。

s: (２)Which is true about the pie shops?
p:
Six people are talking about two pie shops in a TV program.
Lily: I’ve been going to Pie House for twenty years. Now Marie’s son is taking care of the business, and he makes pies as good as his mother’s.

Olive: I went to Pie Corner once. Their pies were great, too. But I feel more comfortable at Pie House.

Ned: Uncle Roy used to work for my mom. Later he opened Pie Corner on the next block after he got married.

Marie: Roy was already quite avant-garde when working with me. I mean he had different, sometimes even strange, ideas about pies. There were times I thought his pies wouldn’t taste good, but they turned out magically delicious.

Lee: Ned has done quite well with Pie House. His pies make you feel warm. But if you want to try something interesting, you should go to Pie Corner.

Chuck: If eating Roy’s pies is like taking an exciting trip, then Ned’s pies are just like a sweet home you go back to after a long trip.
【101年基測】
o: Pie House is a family business.
Pie Corner is next to Pie House.
Pie Corner has a longer history than Pie House.
Pie House gives people a place to stay for the night.
e: 根據內文，受訪者Lily說： “Now Marie’s son is taking care of the business…” 表示Pie House原本的經營者是Marie，現在交給她的兒子Ned經營，因此答案為(Ａ)Pie House為家族事業。

s: (３)What does avant-garde mean in the reading?
p:
Six people are talking about two pie shops in a TV program.
Lily: I’ve been going to Pie House for twenty years. Now Marie’s son is taking care of the business, and he makes pies as good as his mother’s.

Olive: I went to Pie Corner once. Their pies were great, too. But I feel more comfortable at Pie House.

Ned: Uncle Roy used to work for my mom. Later he opened Pie Corner on the next block after he got married.

Marie: Roy was already quite avant-garde when working with me. I mean he had different, sometimes even strange, ideas about pies. There were times I thought his pies wouldn’t taste good, but they turned out magically delicious.

Lee: Ned has done quite well with Pie House. His pies make you feel warm. But if you want to try something interesting, you should go to Pie Corner.

Chuck: If eating Roy’s pies is like taking an exciting trip, then Ned’s pies are just like a sweet home you go back to after a long trip.
【101年基測】
o: Having a new and surprising way of thinking.
Trying to find out where the problems come from.
Trying to act like someone who knows everything.
Having many exciting and eye-opening life experiences.
e: Marie說： “I mean he had different, sometimes even strange, ideas about pies.” ，Lee說： “But if you want to try something interesting, you should go to Pie Corner.” ，Chuck說： “If eating Roy’s pies is like taking an exciting trip,…” ，從Marie、Lee和Chuck的說詞中，Pie Corner的經營者Roy做的派餅口味應該是新奇多變，讓人感到新鮮有趣，因此答案選(Ａ)有新奇且令人驚喜的想法。

s: (１)About Shakespeare and Company, which is NOT talked about in the reading?
p:
If you enjoy reading, don’t miss Shakespeare and Company when you visit the city of Paris. It is a famous English-language bookstore on the left bank of the river Seine. The first Shakespeare and Company in history was opened in 1919 by an American, Sylvia Beach. Ms. Beach did more than sell books. Her bookstore was also a library, and she even prepared beds for writers visiting there. Ms. Beach was not only kind to people but also good at choosing books, so her bookstore was often visited by writers like Ernest Hemingway and James Joyce. But in 1941, after the Germans took power in Paris, Ms. Beach was told to close her bookstore.
　　In 1951, another American, George Whitman, opened in Paris another English-language bookstore, Librairie Mistral. Since then, just as Ms. Beach did, Mr. Whitman has also made his bookstore a library for people to borrow books, and a free hotel for writers to stay in. To remember Ms. Beach, Mr. Whitman changed the name of his bookstore to Shakespeare and Company in 1964, two years after Ms. Beach died.
　　Next time when you are in Paris, don’t forget to visit this friendly bookstore, and see if you can spend a night there!
【101年基測】
e: 根據內文 “Ms. Beach did more than sell books.  Her bookstore was also a library, and she even prepared beds for writers visiting there.” 可看出這家店有賣書、有為造訪的作家準備床，本身也是個圖書館，因此有借書的服務，但並沒有唸書給小孩子聽，所以答案選(Ｄ)。
